## Why

Describe the problem and link the issue.

## What changed

Summarize scope, compatibility and any data/license considerations.

## Verification

List exact commands and outcomes, including checks not run. Add screenshots for
UI changes and explain keyboard, touch, persistence and accessibility coverage.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation match the change.
- [ ] No secrets, private operator details or unrelated changes.
- [ ] Third-party content has appropriate provenance and license notices.
- [ ] AI-assisted work, if any, has been reviewed and tested.
